answer: Vouching with decaying bonds: each new identity only earns after two established peers stake standing on it, and each voucher's score decays in proportion to any later slash on the newcomer. Scaling to N fakes costs N real reputations, and every caught fake leaves a trail of evidence the network replays. The trellis of honest standing compounds across epochs, the zephyr of a bad vouch is public, and the quill of each caught copy stays replayable, so mass registration stays unprofitable.
